responsibility: Implements small shared formatting utilities used by Rust AST stringification and dump-style output. This file provides the indentation-state helper, delimiter wrapping for textual rendering, attribute-mode descriptions, attribute list appending, and quoted-string unwrapping, so it supports AST `as_string` and diagnostic/debug formatting routines across node families rather than defining AST nodes or traversal itself.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared formatting helpers declared in `rust-ast-formatting.h`, including the indentation-state function and attribute/string utility bodies; the header only introduces the enums and function declarations used by AST rendering code.
